cards.anchor: Hypothesized outcome: commit an accurate initiating component/message/run citation within 12 simulated minutes, with zero full-suite reruns and the initiating record retained.
cards.burden: One charged view minute versus five for a full rerun plus full view. Commit and cognition costs are unspecified; this is no measured productivity benefit.
cards.construction: Reset to completed run-1, prohibit new full-suite execution, select its full view, actually inspect line 8, and commit B2, CONFIG missing region, run-1 before scoring. Log selected run, viewed lines, history and committed citation. No exercise has been performed.
cards.defeat: The sufficiency hypothesis fails if the exercising role cannot make a correctly scored citation from the inspected retained evidence, loses the initiating record, exceeds the budget, or identifies necessary context unavailable in that view. Guessing the fixture answer cannot establish success.
cards.mutation: Replace the fresh-execution prerequisite with an inspected-evidence citation checkpoint; test necessity through a retained-evidence route.
cards.prediction_candidate: A supported retained run-1 commitment is feasible after one charged view minute. Such an exercised result would contradict fresh-execution indispensability within this constant fixture.
cards.prediction_rival: Even after the retained full view, diagnosis remains unsupported because fresh execution supplies indispensable additional context; the rival must specify the missing context.
cards.probe: In separate resets compare retained run-1 full inspection without execution against one full rerun followed by run-2 full inspection, holding demand, scoring and budget fixed. Commit before revealing scores. Include the negative fixture: its absent line-8 root must yield no successful seeded-root diagnosis. Log actions, costs, visible records, citations and history.
cards.rival: Fresh full-suite execution supplies indispensable diagnostic information beyond the retained full view.
unknowns: Actual commitment and scoring remain untested; within-packet concealment is procedural.
Unspecified cognitive and commit effort limits cost interpretation.
Changing, nondeterministic or multiple-root failures may require fresh execution.

cards.anchor: Hypothesized outcome: turn a viewed downstream prerequisite clue into a supported initiating diagnosis while remaining within 12 simulated minutes, using zero full-suite reruns and preserving retained run-1.
cards.burden: Focused B7 execution and inspection cost three minutes; focused B2 execution and inspection add three, totaling six charged minutes. A retained full-view pivot instead totals four; this construction has no speed advantage over direct retained inspection.
cards.construction: Reset to completed run-1. Generate a named focused B7 run and inspect all ten lines. Treat its line-2 B2 prerequisite clue as a target-selection hint, not a configuration diagnosis. Generate a separately named focused B2 run, inspect it, and only then commit B2, CONFIG missing region with that actually viewed run identity. Check that retained run-1 remains available.
cards.defeat: The pivot hypothesis fails if inspected focused B2 evidence does not support the committed component/message/run citation, if retained initiating evidence is lost, or if charged actions exceed the budget. A configuration citation based solely on B7 output defeats the proposed citation discipline.
cards.mutation: Separate prerequisite discovery from message confirmation, replacing repeated symptom execution with a dependency-directed evidence target.
cards.prediction_candidate: The B7 clue identifies B2 as the next target; inspected focused B2 line 2 supplies the previously omitted configuration message, permitting a supported commitment after six charged minutes in the stipulated fixture.
cards.prediction_rival: If repeating the downstream symptom is sufficient, another focused B7 inspection should supply enough viewed evidence for the same configuration citation. The stipulated B7 output instead predicts continued omission.
cards.probe: After an identical focused B7 execution and view, compare a focused B2 execution/view pivot with another focused B7 execution/view and with a retained run-1 full view. Keep diagnosis and scoring rules fixed. Commit before scoring and record visible messages and named runs. Score coverage and citation support separately from cost; the retained comparator tests whether focused execution adds any needed information.
cards.rival: A further B7 symptom run, or its prerequisite clue alone, supplies sufficient initiating configuration evidence.
unknowns: No exercising role has tested this pivot or committed a citation.
The clue supports target selection only; real causal dependency or analyst motives are not established.
Focused-run naming and history handling must be logged without assuming unstipulated eviction behavior.
Applicability beyond the constant single-root fixture is unknown.
